selection_guidance: Search by capability tags and platform before selecting a resource; use the alternatives list to compare candidates in the same role.
Treat conflicts as confirmed incompatibilities only; an empty list means no conflict has been established, not that compatibility is proven.

Start with reference-only candidates. Consider dependencies only after checking the exact upstream revision, package and file-level licenses, maintenance, security, compatibility, and commercial terms.
Treat source-visible, mixed-license, commercial, hosted-service, and asset-heavy resources as manual legal and product review; never auto-install or bulk-copy them.
Record upstream evidence URLs, checked date, version or commit, compatibility target, and the decision before changing a target application.

license_policy.research_reported_license: A research lead or commonly reported license signal; not legal clearance and not proof of current upstream terms.
license_policy.verified_upstream_license: Only populated after inspecting the exact upstream license files/notices and relevant package or asset scope.
license_policy.unverified_behavior: All current entries remain unverified for license, provenance, and compatibility. auto_adoption_allowed is false.
license_policy.restricted_resources: Commercial, source-available, mixed-license, hosted-service, or otherwise restricted signals require manual review and are excluded from automatic adoption.
